event_var.var_meaning: recurrence status; likely used as the event indicator paired with pfs.mos.. for progression-free survival/recurrence-free follow-up

notes: The sample metadata explicitly contain 'pfs.mos..' and 'recurrence'.
The paper states that 'Analyses of overall and progression-free survival were performed under Cox proportional hazards assumption,' supporting that PFS was analyzed in this cohort.
Coding is not explicitly defined in GEO; Y is consistent with recurrence/event and N with no recorded recurrence/censoring in many samples.

Some samples have 'recurrence: N' together with death (for example, a dead patient with pfs.mos.. equal to os.mos..), so 'recurrence' may not fully capture all PFS events if death without documented recurrence was counted in the paper's PFS definition.

event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status; 'Dead' indicates death event, 'Alive' indicates censored/alive at last follow-up, and 'Not available' indicates missing status
